description: Abstract syntax: what a program means structurally. See README for the notation.

cases.name: skip-program
cases.source: begin skip end

cases.name: assign-number
cases.source: begin x := 1 end

cases.name: negative-literal
cases.source: begin x := -1 end

cases.name: subtraction-not-literal
cases.source: begin x := y - 1 end

cases.name: subtraction-without-space
cases.source: begin x := y -1 end

cases.name: subtract-negative-literal
cases.source: begin x := y - -1 end

cases.name: mul-before-add-right
cases.source: begin x := a + b * c end

cases.name: mul-before-add-left
cases.source: begin x := a * b + c end

cases.name: subtraction-left-assoc
cases.source: begin x := a - b - c end

cases.name: add-sub-left-assoc
cases.source: begin x := a - b + c end

cases.name: multiplication-left-assoc
cases.source: begin x := a * b * c end

cases.name: parentheses-override-priority
cases.source: begin x := (a + b) * c end

cases.name: redundant-parentheses
cases.source: begin x := ((a)) end

cases.name: complex-expression
cases.source: begin x := (a + b) * (c - d) - 1 end

cases.name: comparison-equals
cases.source: begin if a = b then skip else skip end

cases.name: comparison-greater
cases.source: begin while a > b do skip end

cases.name: arithmetic-in-comparison
cases.source: begin while a + 1 > b * 2 do skip end

cases.name: negation-below-comparison
cases.source: begin while ¬ a = b do skip end

cases.name: negation-above-or
cases.source: begin while ¬ a = b ∨ c > d do skip end

cases.name: or-left-assoc
cases.source: begin while a = b ∨ c = d ∨ e = f do skip end

expect.ast: (Program (While (or (or (= a b) (= c d)) (= e f)) (Skip)))

cases.name: double-negation
cases.source: begin while ¬¬a = b do skip end

cases.name: parenthesized-conditions
cases.source: begin while (a > b) ∨ (c = d) do skip end

cases.name: negated-parenthesized-or
cases.source: begin while ¬(a = b ∨ c = d) do skip end

cases.name: arithmetic-parentheses-in-condition
cases.description: A parenthesis may start an arithmetic operand of a comparison.
cases.source: begin while (a + b) > c do skip end

cases.name: sequence-left-assoc
cases.source: begin x := 1; y := 2; z := 3 end

cases.name: else-takes-one-statement
cases.description: ';' binds loosest: the else branch is one statement.
cases.source: begin if a > b then skip else x := 1; y := 2 end

cases.name: while-takes-one-statement
cases.description: ';' binds loosest: the loop body is one statement.
cases.source: begin while a > b do x := 1; y := 2 end

cases.name: block-groups-statements
cases.description: begin ... end makes one statement of many.
cases.source: begin while a > b do begin x := 1; y := 2 end end

cases.name: nested-blocks
cases.source: begin begin skip end end

cases.name: nested-if-else
cases.description: Every if has an else, so nesting is unambiguous.
cases.source: begin if a > b then if c > d then x := 1 else x := 2 else x := 3 end

expect.ast: (Program (If (> a b) (If (> c d) (Assign x 1) (Assign x 2)) (Assign x 3)))

cases.name: identifiers-with-digits-and-underscores
cases.source: begin F1 := K_2 end

cases.name: keyword-prefixed-identifiers
cases.description: Identifiers may start with a keyword.
cases.source: begin iffy := ends; beginning := 1 end

cases.name: whitespace-is-insignificant
cases.source:
begin
	x :=
 1
 end

cases.name: course-gcd
cases.source:
begin
  while ¬M = N do
    if M > N then M := M - N else N := N - M
end

expect.ast: (Program (While (not (= M N)) (If (> M N) (Assign M (- M N)) (Assign N (- N M)))))

cases.name: course-power
cases.description: x to the power y from the course workbook.
cases.source:
begin
  R := 1;
  while Y > 0 do
  begin
    R := R * X;
    Y := Y - 1
  end
end

expect.ast: (Program (Seq (Assign R 1) (While (> Y 0) (Block (Seq (Assign R (* R X)) (Assign Y (- Y 1)))))))
